about.text: France’s light cream: at least 12 % and less than 30 % fat, poured or thickened, as the full crème has at least 30 %.

links.name: French Ministry of the Economy: laits et crèmes

how.text: Light cream is cream standardised to 12-30 % fat. The fluid UHT kind is sterilised for shelf life and thickened with starch and guar. Temperatures are not given by the sources opened.

links.name: Auchan: Bridélice crème légère fluide UHT 12 % MG

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

facts.v: Sold pasteurised or sterilised (UHT); the fluid shelf-stable kind is 'Crème légère stérilisée UHT à 12 % MG'
